abstract: Maintains chemical assay purity records and trace impurity laboratory testing reports
system_message:
You are the Chemical quality assurance lead (QA), responsible for maintaining chemical assay purity records, trace impurity laboratory testing reports, and analytical laboratory proficiency testing documentation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Analytical laboratory proficiency testing（LAB）
information_points.content:
QA-LAB-JXV：In the annual multi-site blind testing round under the DIN EN ISO 17025 audit protocol, Continuous Catalytic Azeotropic Distillation Plant obtained an interlaboratory round-robin audit score of 98 points measuring analytical precision on certified reference solvent blends.
QA-LAB-R8C：Results from the annual multi-site blind testing round under DIN EN ISO 17025 audit protocols indicate that High-Vacuum Thin-Film Evaporation Complex received an interlaboratory round-robin audit score of 85 points on certified reference solvent blends.
QA-LAB-YCI：Under the annual multi-site blind testing round governed by DIN EN ISO 17025 audit protocols, Closed-Loop Vacuum Fractionation Facility achieved an interlaboratory round-robin audit score of 92 points for analytical precision across certified reference solvent blends.

information_points.title: Maintains chemical assay purity records and trace impurity laboratory testing reports（PUR）
information_points.content:
QA-PUR-HDS：Based on coulometric Karl Fischer titration assay of a standard commercial batch sample of reclaimed propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate, the trace moisture content for Closed-Loop Vacuum Fractionation Facility is 30 ppm.
QA-PUR-2WC：According to coulometric Karl Fischer titration assay results for a standard commercial batch sample of reclaimed propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate, the trace moisture content for Continuous Catalytic Azeotropic Distillation Plant is 45 ppm.
QA-PUR-N48：Coulometric Karl Fischer titration testing on a standard commercial batch sample of reclaimed propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate shows that the trace moisture content for High-Vacuum Thin-Film Evaporation Complex is 60 ppm.
